# Arnab Mandal

> Machine Learning Engineer (Enterprise AI Platform Intern at Fidelity International, Gurgaon). Specializes in GenAI applications, systems-level engineering, LLM inference optimization, and RAG architectures. Portfolio at https://arnab-mandal-portfolio.vercel.app.

Arnab builds logic-powered products that work — from speculative decoding for vLLM to PII redaction and document guardrails at scale. Tagline: "I like finetuning small language models."

## Featured Projects

- [Domino Speculative Decoding for vLLM](https://github.com/arnabwithab/speculators): Implemented Domino speculative decoding with distributed training in vLLM; optimized kernels for improved throughput on Qwen3
- [AutoLinks: Distributed Semantic Internal Linking Engine](https://github.com/arnabwithab/AutoLinks): Built async Go workers with Redis queue + DLQ for distributed link generation; added LLM-as-a-judge re-ranking via GLiNER + Qdrant — live at https://autolinks.vercel.app
- [AuthChain](https://github.com/arnabwithab/AuthChain): Cryptographic governance & consensus for autonomous agents; interruption-driven control with blockchain-audited execution — live at https://auth-chain-five.vercel.app
- [Llava Inference via TensorRT and Triton](https://github.com/arnabwithab/Llava_Inference_TensorRT_Triton): Custom docs and forked Triton/TensorRT for efficient multimodal VLM inference
- [Krishi AI Sahayak](https://github.com/arnabwithab/SIH25-Farmers): Unified API + Android app for farmers — live at https://sih25-farmers.onrender.com/docs
- [RAG-Toolkit](https://github.com/arnabwithab/RagToolkitServer): Modular GPU-accelerated RAG system with FastAPI + Streamlit, llama-cpp-python
- [GPT-2 Style LLM from Scratch](https://github.com/arnabwithab/GPT-2_LLM_Architecture): Tokenization, multi-head attention, positional encodings in PyTorch/NumPy — and 20 more in the archive

- [VBC Healthcare Client — Freelance AI Engineer (2026-02 to 2026-04)](https://arnab-mandal-portfolio.vercel.app/#experience): Deployed multi-agent Text2SQL engine with sandboxed-agent execution serving 21 orgs and 200+ users on AWS
- [DeepLure AI Research — AI Engineer Intern (2025-12 to 2026-01, Remote)](https://arnab-mandal-portfolio.vercel.app/#experience): Migrated inference stack from native PyTorch to TensorRT + Triton

- [WESEE, Ministry of Defence — AI Intern (2025-06 to 2025-07, India)](https://arnab-mandal-portfolio.vercel.app/#experience): Built MCP servers for internal chatbot towards early, security-first AI adoption
